description: Header file defining the 'GraphicBuffer' class used in Android graphics framework, including buffer management, locking, and handle operations.

classes.name: GraphicBuffer
classes.description: Represents a graphics buffer with methods for creation, reallocation, locking, and handle management.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a sp<GraphicBuffer> from an ANativeWindowBuffer.

methods.name: fromAHardwareBuffer
methods.description: Creates a GraphicBuffer from an AHardwareBuffer pointer.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks the initialization status of the buffer.

methods.name: reallocate
methods.description: Reallocates the buffer with new size and format parameters.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for access, returning a pointer to the memory.

methods.name: addDeathCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when the buffer is destroyed.
